_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_gang_exception.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_exception_ongoing: On the booked-out floor, the usual routine occasionally takes a different turn.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_exception_result: The routine goes on, but today brings a few interludes.
en-us.event_erav_gang_exception_01:
Deep in the night a green recruit, mid-act on top of her, suddenly stops and asks the question he shouldn't:
"...That supervisor of yours. Is he good to you?"
She freezes, no answer ready. He doesn't wait for one - he starts moving again, grinding the question to nothing inside her with the rhythm.
en-us.event_erav_gang_exception_02:
Toward evening two of the guys nearly come to blows over who goes first. The card table's air freezes - until the wakagashira's palm cracks on the table:
"Fight like idiots. Mouth and down below, split the duty. Done."
Problem solved. She is rearranged, opening her mouth to take on both jobs.
en-us.event_erav_gang_exception_03:
Packing up the last morning, one of the guys stuffs his unfinished rice ball into her bag, scratching his head.
"For the road. ...So, uh, next time the gang hands out a bonus, might be you again. So - see you then."
She carries her bag downstairs. At the stair's turn the whole floor's laughter rolls up from behind, mixed with somebody's catcall:
"Come again sometime-!"
